outcome: Control the room, not a list of bulbs.

views.title: Room controls
views.condition: Tap the tablet, or approach it with Controls on approach switched on; lights, covers and timers appear when configured. With actions in Ramka 0.16.0 or later, one-tap shortcuts to a button, script or scene, such as a gate remote's, sit under the awnings, each behind Home Assistant's confirmation unless it sets confirm: false.
views.layout: Ramka landscape layout: 1024–1280 × 720–800 CSS px; phone/portrait dashboard not claimed.

setup: Set up the Hue Bridge and room groups, then connect its Home Assistant integration.
Map the room light entities in your home inputs.
Verify group state and brightness; configure Ramka lights inputs for tablet controls.

Optional, from 0.5.0: list presence rooms (an occupancy sensor per room, optionally a darkness and a distance sensor) so the room's Hue group switches on when someone comes in while it is dark and off a set time after the room is empty; run it on one Home Assistant per Hue group and remove any local automation on the same group.
